Printable family guide

Family Discussion Guide

You’re already welcome here—short answers and quiet count more than a polished discussion.

Use this with Family Worship in the Trenches, Psalms of Comfort (Family Edition), or one verse from the family hub. Keep it short. Calm counts.

1. Read the verse aloud twice

The first read lets everyone hear it. The second read helps one word land.

Verse / reference:

2. See

Ask: What word or phrase stood out?

3. Understand

Ask: What does this show us about God?

4. Live

Ask: What is one small thing we can do today because this is true?

5. Pray one honest sentence

6. One mercy-first reminder

  • Silence is allowed.
  • Short is not shallow.
  • One verse is enough for tonight.
